changes.title: Rattlesnake scorpion
items: Two new animals for the badlands islands: the rattlesnake, sidewinding across the cactus flats and rattling its warning when you come near, and the scorpion, out on the red canyon's rocks under the moon
Their legends: an ancient horned rattlesnake on great coils whose rattle ripples the sand, and an elder scorpion carrying its young on its back, glowing blue-green at its seams

changes.title: Audio buffer
items: The music should stop cutting out on busy laptops: the sound now asks for a bigger output buffer, and a computer that still struggles asks for more next time
The music stays on the beat the game shows, scheduled early by the sound's own delay

changes.title: Canopy hider
items: Coming down from the treetops, the canopy now opens round you smoothly as the camera comes down, and closes as you rise, instead of switching all at once
